title: Current evidenced runtime/renderer heads and provenance boundaries
summary: Use exact evidenced artifacts and distinguish executable integration heads, renderer-specific heads and development/recovery lines. Do not infer renderer versions from host tooling or silently substitute an older/newer package with a different evidence boundary.
invariants: Package identity is exact artifact plus digest, not version-like filename alone.
Renderer-head evidence and host/runtime-tooling evidence are separate; do not call Android renderer dev16 merely because native host tooling is dev16.
Application integration may pin an older renderer runtime than a separately qualified development head; record both rather than silently substituting.
Direct Linux dev38 metadata mismatch is explicit missing work, not provenance to repair in documentation.
Sphere authority is documentation/continuity only; it does not supersede executable packages.
